hours.description: Number of hours of timezone differences to display.

format.description: Output format string compatible with date(1).

timezones.description: List of timezone identifiers (e.g., 'Asia/Tokyo', 'Europe/London'). If empty, lists all available zones.

start_time.description: Start time for the display window. Flexible format like 'YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM' or 'now'.

full_names.description: If true, display full timezone name (region/city).

round_to_hour.description: If true, round down displayed times to the nearest hour.

scripting_mode.description: If true, use scripting mode with TAB separators.

no_local.description: If true, do not display the local timezone column.
